reason: B is better grounded and more testable because it links measurable diffusion resistance and vacancy-mediated activation barriers to cited multicomponent-alloy evidence, while specifying annealing comparisons and falsifying observations. Its causal claim that configurational entropy itself increases packing density and cohesive energy remains overstated, and the lower-component control is compositionally confounded, but A relies on the less sound notion of uniform entropy-induced lattice distortion and provides no supporting evidence.
